limitations: Exact matching cannot label sequencing-error paths that differ from the reference.
Multiple reference-compatible paths are left ambiguous; one reference does not establish variant truth.
This report evaluates graph bubble selection only and does not emit or benchmark contig assemblies.
Reads are not strand-normalized; graph orientation follows the input records.
protocol.read_selection: seeded reservoir sample without replacement over ordered input records
protocol.reference_matching: exact substring match of reconstructed candidate sequence
